channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brad Wanamaker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brad Wanamaker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: James Borrego on Brad Wanamaker
item.description:
Rod Boone:Borrego on Brad Wanamaker:

“The first thing is just getting him in the door and comfortable in our system and then we'll move from there, but he's a veteran. This guy is not going to take a whole lot of time to get up to speed. He knows our system. He's watched us from afar.”

James Borrego on Brad Wanamaker, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker:

“I love Brad, and I feel for him that he's not going to be in the rotation right now.”

Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker, Mar 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker going 4-for-26 from deep the last 15 games:

“I know Brad is frustrated. I feel his pain. Really hard role to play, but it's one you sort of have to learn how to play. Brad is way too good of a shooter to not eventually get going.”

Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker, Feb 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Steve Kerr on the Brad Wanamaker addition, who played last season for the Celtics, who they play tomorrow night:

“I love Brad. He's a guy who I just trust whenever I put him out there. I just trust him. And it was that way from day one.”

Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker, Feb 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker:

“I watched him quite a bit while he was in the bubble. I really, really liked his game -- admired his toughness and his stability ... I could see him even playing with Steph. I like his demeanor. He's just a real pro.”

Steve Kerr on Brad Wanamaker, Dec 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.
